name: The Overmyer Building (former Commerce Paper Co.), Ontario St, Warehouse District
refs: refs/w235558620/00 (The Commerce Paper Company Building in Downtown Toledo, Ohio, September 2019, Wikimedia Commons)
notes: 8-storey red-brick warehouse: brick piers between bays of grouped steel-sash windows, plain cornice band, one long flank largely blank where a neighbour was demolished.
